'''Silas Fleetfire''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[war against Zakuul]]. On [[Darvannis]], she helped assist the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans and the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] with the supplies she brought with her to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
